item.title: New Sota RC 1/10th Scale Off-Road Pistons
item.description: SOTA is proud to introduce a new benchmark in RC shock piston design. At a glance it may look unconventional, but this piston delivers a level of damping control and tuning depth previously reserved for full-scale motorsport — now in RC.

item.title: New VP-Pro Touring Car Tire Bands
item.description: VP-Pro has added extra small size version to their tire mounting band group. Specifically designed for holding tires down during the gluing process for touring car tires.

item.title: New ALF1 Carbon Fiber Damper Plate and Battery Mount
item.description: ALF1 has released a new carbon fiber Battery Mount as well as carbon fiber Damper Plate.

item.title: New Hong-Nor X5B Aluminum Front Top Deck
item.description: Hong Nor has released a new 7075-T6 CNC front top deck for the X5B, which reduces body twist and improves cornering stability.

item.title: 2026 JConcepts Off-Road Jam Results
item.description: Despite winter weather forecasts that at one point called for up to 15 inches of snow (spoiler alert: they were very wrong), nearly 200 entries braved the cold and packed Fastlane Raceway for another unforgettable Offroad JAM weekend.

item.title: Jeff Statkiewicz Joins Team Yokomo USA
item.description: Team Yokom USA is beyond excited to have Jeff Statkiewicz join the team for 2026.

item.title: New Mon-Tech Racing A-6R 190mm TC Body
item.description: Mon-Tech Racing is pleased to present their new 190 mm Touring Car body shell. The new A-6R represents the latest evolution of 1/10 scale Touring Car bodies.

item.title: New VP-Pro Hyperdrive Evo 1/8th Buggy Tire
item.description: VP-Pro is excited to launch their new tire for 1/8 scale Buggy, the VP-817 Hyperdrive Evo.

item.title: New Factory Team 1/28th Scale Aluminum Pinion Sets
item.description: A new line of aluminum pinion gears are now available from Factory Team! These pinion gear sets all come with three pinion gears, and are offered in three different ranges, depending on which 1/28th scale motor is being used.

item.title: Practicing Tips and Tricks With The Drake [VIDEO]
item.description: Mugen Seiki Racing's Adam Drake gives tips for how to practice with a purpose to help improve your driving. Vehicle preparation, set-up adjustments, and having a plan to help improve race program.
